extracted.intended_audience: CIA management, Special Security Center staff, and US Intelligence Community security officials responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44
extracted.subtask_description: Agency-level guidance for implementing OMB Circular A-44 (revised) within the CIA, focusing on management improvement contributions from the Special Security Center, management effectiveness goals (security policy/direction), and cost-reduction expectations for FY1971.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special Security Center contribution to Agency management improvement program
rubrics_metrics.description: The Special Security Center's contribution toward the Agency's management improvement program as directed by the Executive Director–Comptroller.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This memorandum/attachment is presented as the SSC contribution; it should align with directives from the Executive Director–Comptroller and reflect the SSC's responsibilities in security-related management improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Effectiveness Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide security policy, direction and guidance to the US Intelligence Community on three compartmented security control systems established to protect sensitive intelligence sources and methods. Provide guidance to the [internal] controls employed to protect highly sensitive US intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on policy/direction/guidance roles: identify the three compartmented control systems, describe their purpose (protection of sensitive sources and methods), and specify guidance for controls protecting highly sensitive intelligence. Emphasize interagency direction to the Intelligence Community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost-Reduction Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless there is a policy change at the highest level affecting the classification of compartmented programs, it is not expected that there will be any earnings measurably in dollars or manpower for FY 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set realistic expectations: unless classification or policy changes, do not expect measurable dollar or manpower savings for the stated fiscal year. Cost-reduction planning should account for constraints imposed by classification/policy on compartmented programs.
